usage.scope: Seven route soundscapes, 21 postcard scenes and 29 artwork encounters.
usage.processing: Existing recordings are filtered, rate-adjusted and mixed at runtime with original synthesized wind, surf, rain, snow and material foley. No new field recordings were downloaded.
usage.disclosure: Not local recordings. The surf texture is sound design combining filtered water with synthesized waves; paper foley comes from recorded leaves.
